newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0800 CST.
LIVE CATTLE - Off 0.100 to 0.200 cent. Lower cash fed cattle trade late Tuesday and technically weak.
FEEDER CATTLE - Steady. Feeder index higher but spillover from live cattle likely. Corn futures also seen steady to up.
LEAN HOGS - Up 0.100 to off 0.200 cent. Steadier than expected cash hogs but pork cutout easier and hog runs could increase during the day.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.100 to 0.300 cent. Product steady to weak and increase in deliverable stocks.
